meta.name: Flight Of The Living Dead
meta.description: On a flight from Los Angeles to Paris, a mad scientist on the run from the CIA is transporting a coffin containing the body of a colleague infected with a genetically modified virus. While the 747 crosses a violent thunderstorm, the instability of the aircraft allows the corpse to get out of its container.
meta.slogan: At 30,000 feet, there's no where to run.
